passage:
The student council wanted more bike parking. Instead of only asking, they counted bikes every morning for two months.
They recorded weather, day of the week, and how many bikes were parked outside the official area.
The data showed clear need. On sunny days, bike spaces were full before school started.
The principal approved new racks.
Students learned that patient counting can turn a request into a plan. Complaints may be heard and forgotten. Evidence is harder to ignore.
Civic action is not only protest. Sometimes it is standing at the gate with a clipboard every morning.
